title: Efficacy and Safety of Idelalisib in Combination With Ofatumumab for Previously Treated Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia
brief_summary: The primary objective of this study is to evaluate the effect of the addition of idelalisib to ofatumumab on progression-free survival (PFS) in participants with previously treated chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL).
raw_criteria:
Key Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults with previously treated recurrent CLL who have measurable lymphadenopathy
* Require therapy for CLL
* Have experienced CLL progression \< 24 months since the completion of the last prior therapy
* Have disease that is not refractory to ofatumumab

Note: Other protocol defined Inclusion/Exclusion criteria may apply.
